name: Mayura Peacock Brocade Saree
description: A spectacular peacock brocade saree woven in Varanasi with intricate zari work depicting the beauty of the peacock feather. The rich katan silk base gives it an unmatched drape and sheen.
careInstructions: Dry Clean Only: Entrust your saree to professionals who specialize in luxury fabrics.
Storage: Wrap your saree in unbleached muslin cotton cloth and store in a dry, dark place away from direct sunlight.
Air Regularly: Unfold and air the saree in gentle shade every few months to preserve the silk lustre.

name: Zardosi Emerald Katan Silk Saree
description: Crafted in Varanasi using traditional kadhua weaving techniques, featuring intricate floral vines in antique gold zardosi work on a rich emerald green katan silk base.
careInstructions: Dry Clean Only: Entrust your saree to professionals who specialize in luxury fabrics.
Storage: Wrap your saree in unbleached muslin cotton cloth.
Air Regularly: Unfold and air the saree every few months.

name: Nava Benarasi Organza Saree
description: A diaphanous organza saree with delicate rose gold zari borders and scattered butti motifs. Perfect for summer weddings and receptions.
careInstructions: Store in a cool, dry place.

name: Patola Double Ikat Masterpiece
description: A prized double ikat Patola saree from Patan, Gujarat — one of the rarest weaves in the world. Each geometric motif is resist-dyed before weaving to achieve perfect symmetry.
careInstructions: Store wrapped separately in soft muslin.
Never wring or twist the fabric.

name: Mayurpankh Crimson Brocade Saree
description: A magnificent Kanjeevaram saree in deep crimson with a contrasting gold border, woven using pure mulberry silk threads and genuine 24k gold-tested zari.
careInstructions: Store in a silk bag or muslin cloth.

name: Varanasi Royal Kanjeevaram
description: A timeless deep maroon saree with antique gold zari border. The rich mulberry silk base drapes beautifully and the zari work adds a royal touch.
careInstructions: Store in a cool, dark place.
Air regularly to maintain silk sheen.

name: Chanderi Tissue Organza Saree
description: A lightweight Chanderi tissue saree with delicate silver zari weave. The silk-cotton blend gives it a comfortable drape perfect for daywear and casual occasions.
careInstructions: Can be gently hand washed in cold water.
Do not wring; dry in shade.

name: Banarasi Jamdani Floral Silk
description: An exquisite Banarasi Jamdani saree with floral discontinuous supplementary weft technique. The delicate pastel pink base with gold motifs makes it perfect for festive celebrations.
careInstructions: Store flat in a cool, dry place.
Handle with care to preserve the delicate jamdani work.

name: Mysore Georgette Crepe Saree
description: A flowing Mysore georgette saree with delicate silver embroidery. The lightweight fabric drapes effortlessly and is perfect for parties and evening events.

name: Uppada Jamdani Pure Silk Saree
description: A rare Uppada Jamdani saree from coastal Andhra Pradesh, known for its ultra-lightweight feel and intricate jamdani patterns woven in gold zari on a turquoise silk base.

name: Dharmavaram Pure Silk Saree
description: A grand Dharmavaram silk saree in bottle green with a broad gold zari border. Perfect for weddings and special occasions.
careInstructions: Store with mothballs in a cool place.

name: Kanjivaram Pure Silk Temple Border
description: A regal Kanjivaram saree in royal purple with a classic temple border in antique gold zari. The contrast pallu adds drama and elegance to this timeless piece.
